rows.speaker: Gengoro
rows.en: ...So, what does Mr. Martino have to say about it?
rows.display_text:
「...So, what does Mr. Martino have to
say about it?」

rows.speaker: Kazami
rows.en: What he sold to Sandman was only the Trinity Energy patent and the completed God Sigma unit...
rows.display_text:
「What he sold to Sandman was only the
Trinity Energy patent and the completed
God Sigma unit...」

rows.speaker: Kazami
rows.en: He insists the God Sigma design itself is still his own property.
rows.display_text:
「He insists the God Sigma design itself
is still his own property.」

rows.speaker: Rie
rows.en: Can a claim like that possibly hold up?
rows.display_text: 「Can a claim like that possibly hold up?」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: That man's a shrewd businessman, for all his faults. He probably agreed to the contract with this exact loophole in mind.
rows.display_text:
「That man's a shrewd businessman, faults
aside. He probably agreed to the contract
with this exact loophole in mind.」

rows.speaker: Ichitaro
rows.en: Then can whoever buys those blueprints actually build a God Sigma?
rows.display_text:
「Then can whoever buys those blueprints
actually build a God Sigma?」

rows.speaker: Kazami
rows.en: No need to worry about that. Without Trinity Energy, God Sigma can never be completed.
rows.display_text:
「No need to worry about that. Without
Trinity Energy, God Sigma can never be
completed.」

rows.speaker: Kazami
rows.en: Every reference to Trinity Energy has been stripped from the blueprints being sold...
rows.display_text:
「Every reference to Trinity Energy has
been stripped from the blueprints being
sold...」

rows.speaker: Kazami
rows.en: They'd be good for nothing more than reference material on the drive system and combination mechanism.
rows.display_text:
「They'd be good for nothing more than
reference material on the drive system
and combination mechanism.」

rows.speaker: Gengoro
rows.en: So with an ordinary engine, it'd only be usable as a work robot.
rows.display_text:
「So with an ordinary engine, it'd only be
usable as a work robot.」

rows.speaker: Rie
rows.en: Still, it's a design by the Doctor and Julie. That alone makes it more than sellable.
rows.display_text:
「Still, it's a design by the Doctor and
Julie. That alone makes it more than
sellable.」

rows.speaker: Hanae
rows.en: We have a contact on radar!
rows.display_text: 「We have a contact on radar!」

rows.speaker: Umee
rows.en: This is bad, everyone! Aliens are coming in from above!
rows.display_text:
「This is bad, everyone! Aliens are coming
in from above!」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: Launch all units! We're intercepting the alien force!
rows.display_text:
「Launch all units! We're intercepting the
alien force!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: So you've finally shown up, you Eldar bastards!
rows.display_text:
「So you've finally shown up, you Eldar
bastards!」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: All units, stay sharp. The enemy is clearly targeting us specifically.
rows.display_text:
「All units, stay sharp. The enemy is
clearly targeting us specifically.」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: So they're confident they can win, huh.
rows.display_text: 「So they're confident they can win, huh.」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: Bring it on! Let's turn the tables on them!
rows.display_text:
「Bring it on! Let's turn the tables on
them!」

rows.speaker: Rietz
rows.en: Commander Teral, all units have already completed their attack preparations.
rows.display_text:
「Commander Teral, all units have already
completed their attack preparations.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: Supreme Commander Gattler valued my resolve and entrusted this fleet to me. I must repay that trust.
rows.display_text:
「Supreme Commander Gattler valued my
resolve and entrusted this fleet to me. I
must repay that trust.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: Begin the attack! Whatever it takes, we will destroy God Sigma in this battle!
rows.display_text:
「Begin the attack! Whatever it takes, we
will destroy God Sigma in this battle!」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Toshiya! The longer this drags on, the worse it gets for us!
rows.display_text:
「Toshiya! The longer this drags on, the
worse it gets for us!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Right! We'll hit their mothership and settle this!
rows.display_text:
「Right! We'll hit their mothership and
settle this!」

rows.speaker: Kiraken
rows.en: Whoa! I can't just sit still through this! We're joining the fight too!
rows.display_text:
「Whoa! I can't just sit still through
this! We're joining the fight too!」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Toshiya! God Sigma is clear to launch!
rows.display_text: 「Toshiya! God Sigma is clear to launch!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: All right! We'll hit their mothership and settle this!
rows.display_text:
「All right! We'll hit their mothership and
settle this!」

rows.speaker: Jeela
rows.en: Commander Teral! God Sigma is closing in!
rows.display_text:
「Commander Teral! God Sigma is closing
in!」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: This is our chance! Launch the Jerogiras Sniper Type!
rows.display_text:
「This is our chance! Launch the
Jerogiras Sniper Type!」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Watch out! The Cosmosaurus is coming!
rows.display_text: 「Watch out! The Cosmosaurus is coming!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Who cares! We're plowing straight through!
rows.display_text:
「Who cares! We're plowing straight
through!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Toshiya!
rows.display_text: 「Toshiya!」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: God Sigma won't be stopped by something like that! Go, Toshiya!!
rows.display_text:
「God Sigma won't be stopped by
something like that! Go, Toshiya!!」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: What are you doing!? If you stop moving, you'll be finished!
rows.display_text:
「What are you doing!? If you stop
moving, you'll be finished!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: What!? What's happening!? God Sigma won't move!!
rows.display_text:
「What!? What's happening!? God Sigma
won't move!!」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Impossible! Damage like that shouldn't be enough to disable it!
rows.display_text:
「Impossible! Damage like that shouldn't
be enough to disable it!」

rows.speaker: Kazami
rows.en: Rie, I need an analysis! The hit landed on the waist section... it's likely near circuit number 1358!
rows.display_text:
「Rie, I need an analysis! The hit landed
on the waist section... it's likely near
circuit number 1358!」

rows.speaker: Rie
rows.en: Y-yes!
rows.display_text: 「Y-yes!」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: Now! Concentrate all fire on God Sigma!
rows.display_text: 「Now! Concentrate all fire on God Sigma!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Gah!!
rows.display_text: 「Gah!!」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: All surrounding units, hold the rest of the enemy back! This ship will bring God Sigma down!
rows.display_text:
「All surrounding units, hold the rest of
the enemy back! This ship will bring God
Sigma down!」

rows.speaker: Minako
rows.en: Toshiya, run!!
rows.display_text: 「Toshiya, run!!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: No good...! We can't even separate!!
rows.display_text: 「No good...! We can't even separate!!」

rows.speaker: Rie
rows.en: Doctor, the analysis is in! A malfunction has been found in circuit number 1359!
rows.display_text:
「Doctor, the analysis is in! A
malfunction has been found in circuit
number 1359!」

rows.speaker: Rie
rows.en: I'm putting the situation up on the monitor!
rows.display_text:
「I'm putting the situation up on the
monitor!」

rows.speaker: Kazami
rows.en: Good god...! This is a design flaw--my design flaw!
rows.display_text:
「Good god...! This is a design flaw--my
design flaw!」

rows.speaker: Gengoro
rows.en: What do you mean by that, Doctor!?
rows.display_text: 「What do you mean by that, Doctor!?」

rows.speaker: Kazami
rows.en: If a blow lands on God Sigma's waist at a specific timing and angle...
rows.display_text:
「If a blow lands on God Sigma's waist at
a specific timing and angle...」

rows.speaker: Kazami
rows.en: ...circuit 1359 short-circuits, and God Sigma's overall performance drops by 98 percent...!
rows.display_text:
「...circuit 1359 short-circuits, and God
Sigma's overall performance drops by 98
percent...!」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: The Eldar forces clearly aimed for that exact spot...!
rows.display_text:
「The Eldar forces clearly aimed for that
exact spot...!」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: Are you saying they knew God Sigma's weak point!?
rows.display_text:
「Are you saying they knew God Sigma's
weak point!?」

rows.speaker: Umee
rows.en: What's wrong, Minako?
rows.display_text: 「What's wrong, Minako?」

rows.speaker: Minako
rows.en: That's... Dad...
rows.display_text: 「That's... Dad...」

rows.speaker: Minako
rows.en: The Eldar got hold of the blueprints Dad sold, and that's how they found out!
rows.display_text:
「The Eldar got hold of the blueprints
Dad sold, and that's how they found out!」

rows.speaker: Rie
rows.en: Doctor! If we set up a bypass in the circuitry around 1359, God Sigma's functions will recover!
rows.display_text:
「Doctor! If we set up a bypass in the
circuitry around 1359, God Sigma's
functions will recover!」

rows.speaker: Kazami
rows.en: But to do that, someone has to input the settings into the unit's sub-computer from outside...!
rows.display_text:
「But to do that, someone has to input
the settings into the unit's sub-computer
from outside...!」

rows.speaker: Minako
rows.en: I-I'll go!
rows.display_text: 「I-I'll go!」

rows.speaker: Kazami
rows.en: Minako...!
rows.display_text: 「Minako...!」

rows.speaker: Minako
rows.en: It's because of what my dad did that Toshiya's in danger...! I'm going!
rows.display_text:
「It's because of what my dad did that
Toshiya's in danger...! I'm going!」

rows.speaker: Rie
rows.en: Setting up the bypass isn't something you can do, Minako.
rows.display_text:
「Setting up the bypass isn't something
you can do, Minako.」

rows.speaker: Minako
rows.en: But...

rows.speaker: Rie
rows.en: It's all right. I'll go too.
rows.display_text: 「It's all right. I'll go too.」

rows.speaker: Minako
rows.en: Rie...

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: No good...! At this rate, all we can do is wait to be finished off!
rows.display_text:
「No good...! At this rate, all we can do
is wait to be finished off!」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Isn't that a shopping TFO!? Who's piloting it!?
rows.display_text:
「Isn't that a shopping TFO!? Who's
piloting it!?」

rows.speaker: Rie
rows.en: Toshiya!
rows.display_text: 「Toshiya!」

rows.speaker: Minako
rows.en: I'm coming, hang on!!
rows.display_text: 「I'm coming, hang on!!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Rie! Minako!
rows.display_text: 「Rie! Minako!」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Both of you, turn back! It's too dangerous!!
rows.display_text:
「Both of you, turn back! It's too
dangerous!!」

rows.speaker: Minako
rows.en: Quit yammering at me! I know that without being told!
rows.display_text:
「Quit yammering at me! I know that
without being told!」

rows.speaker: Rie
rows.en: Toshiya...! I'm going to save you!
rows.display_text: 「Toshiya...! I'm going to save you!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Rie...

rows.speaker: Rie
rows.en: I won't let you die!
rows.display_text: 「I won't let you die!」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: (That girl... risking her own life for Toshiya Dan...!)
rows.display_text:
（(That girl... risking her own life for
Toshiya Dan...!)）

rows.speaker: Kiraken
rows.en: God Sigma's power is coming back!
rows.display_text: 「God Sigma's power is coming back!」

rows.speaker: Rie
rows.en: The bypass setup is complete! It should be fine now!
rows.display_text:
「The bypass setup is complete! It should
be fine now!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Sorry, Rie! Minako!
rows.display_text: 「Sorry, Rie! Minako!」

rows.speaker: Minako
rows.en: Do your best, Toshiya! Take those Eldar down!!
rows.display_text:
「Do your best, Toshiya! Take those Eldar
down!!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: You've got some nerve! Time to pay you back for all of this!!
rows.display_text:
「You've got some nerve! Time to pay you
back for all of this!!」

rows.speaker: Rietz
rows.en: Damn these wretched Earthlings! I'll deal with the small fry who got in our way first!
rows.display_text:
「Damn these wretched Earthlings! I'll
deal with the small fry who got in our
way first!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Rie!!
rows.display_text: 「Rie!!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: I'm not letting you die--not after you risked your life to save God Sigma.
rows.display_text:
「I'm not letting you die--not after you
risked your life to save God Sigma.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: (It's the same... The same as back then, when Teral sacrificed everything to save me...)
rows.display_text:
（(It's the same... The same as back
then, when Teral sacrificed everything to
save me...)）

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: (Toshiya Dan and that girl... They carry the same heart that Teral and I once did...)
rows.display_text:
（(Toshiya Dan and that girl... They
carry the same heart that Teral and I
once did...)）

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Get back, Rie! We'll handle the rest!
rows.display_text: 「Get back, Rie! We'll handle the rest!」

rows.speaker: Rie
rows.en: Right!
rows.display_text: 「Right!」

rows.speaker: Minako
rows.en: (Ugh... it's like the two of them are in their own little world...!)
rows.display_text:
（(Ugh... it's like the two of them are
in their own little world...!)）

rows.speaker: Rietz
rows.en: Commander Teral, your orders!
rows.display_text: 「Commander Teral, your orders!」

rows.speaker: Jeela
rows.en: Commander Teral...!
rows.display_text: 「Commander Teral...!」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: A-all forces, attack! Our plan's been foiled, but that doesn't mean we've lost!
rows.display_text:
「A-all forces, attack! Our plan's been
foiled, but that doesn't mean we've lost!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Here I come, Eldar! I'll pay you back double for this!!
rows.display_text:
「Here I come, Eldar! I'll pay you back
double for this!!」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: Fall back, Toshiya. God Sigma can't fight anymore.
rows.display_text:
「Fall back, Toshiya. God Sigma can't
fight anymore.」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: Leave the rest to us! We'll pay back double whatever damage you guys took!
rows.display_text:
「Leave the rest to us! We'll pay back
double whatever damage you guys took!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Sorry! I'm counting on you all!
rows.display_text: 「Sorry! I'm counting on you all!」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: Ngh...! Is this as far as we go? All forces, retreat!!
rows.display_text:
「Ngh...! Is this as far as we go? All
forces, retreat!!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Phew... for a minute there, I really thought I was done for.
rows.display_text:
「Phew... for a minute there, I really
thought I was done for.」

rows.speaker: Sayaka
rows.en: We were saved thanks to Rie and Minako.
rows.display_text:
「We were saved thanks to Rie and
Minako.」

rows.speaker: Mizuki
rows.en: That's the hidden strength of a woman in love for you.
rows.display_text:
「That's the hidden strength of a woman
in love for you.」

rows.speaker: Lunamaria
rows.en: I'm kind of curious which one Toshiya will choose.
rows.display_text:
「I'm kind of curious which one Toshiya
will choose.」

rows.speaker: Keiko
rows.en: Gentle Rie, lively Minako... They're both wonderful in their own way.
rows.display_text:
「Gentle Rie, lively Minako... They're both
wonderful in their own way.」

rows.speaker: Luna
rows.en: Being popular with both of them--way to go, Toshiya~!
rows.display_text:
「Being popular with both of them--way
to go, Toshiya~!」

rows.speaker: Kiraken
rows.en: Hold on! Julie and I are riding in God Sigma too, you know!
rows.display_text:
「Hold on! Julie and I are riding in God
Sigma too, you know!」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Don't be so uncouth about it. Toshiya's got enough on his plate as it is.
rows.display_text:
「Don't be so uncouth about it. Toshiya's
got enough on his plate as it is.」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Did you say something, Julie?
rows.display_text: 「Did you say something, Julie?」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Heh... rough life, being popular.
rows.display_text: 「Heh... rough life, being popular.」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: (Well... it's rough on Minako, but from how today went, the answer seems pretty clear already.)
rows.display_text:
（(Well... it's rough on Minako, but from
how today went, the answer seems pretty
clear already.)）

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: (Watch over me, Teral...! I will destroy God Sigma without fail, and save Eldar's tomorrow!)
rows.display_text:
（(Watch over me, Teral...! I will
destroy God Sigma without fail, and save
Eldar's tomorrow!)）

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: (Teral... the man I came to acknowledge, Toshiya Dan, already has someone he loves.)
rows.display_text:
（(Teral... the man I came to
acknowledge, Toshiya Dan, already has
someone he loves.)）

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: (But I must fight. Even if that girl sheds the same tears I once did, I must still destroy God Sigma!)
rows.display_text:
（(But I must fight. Even if that girl
sheds the same tears I once did, I must
still destroy God Sigma!)）

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: This mission was a long journey... Was it hard on you, Lira?
rows.display_text:
「This mission was a long journey... Was
it hard on you, Lira?」

rows.speaker: Lira
rows.en: As long as I'm with you, Teral, I can endure anything.
rows.display_text:
「As long as I'm with you, Teral, I can
endure anything.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: Thank you, Lira. Your presence is more of a comfort to me than anything else.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you, Lira. Your presence is more
of a comfort to me than anything else.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: But even once we return to our homeworld, Eldar, I'll have to take up my next mission right away.
rows.display_text:
「But even once we return to our
homeworld, Eldar, I'll have to take up my
next mission right away.」

rows.speaker: Lira
rows.en: After fighting Earthlings out on the frontier, and now right away again...?
rows.display_text:
「After fighting Earthlings out on the
frontier, and now right away again...?」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: Lira... you're the only one I'll tell about my next mission.
rows.display_text:
「Lira... you're the only one I'll tell
about my next mission.」

rows.speaker: Lira
rows.en: Teral...
rows.display_text: 「Teral...」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: Trinity Energy--Earth's trump card, and Eldar's mortal enemy...
rows.display_text:
「Trinity Energy--Earth's trump card, and
Eldar's mortal enemy...」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: It's a super-energy capable of nullifying any barrier and blowing apart an entire planet in an instant.
rows.display_text:
「It's a super-energy capable of
nullifying any barrier and blowing apart
an entire planet in an instant.」

rows.speaker: Lira
rows.en: I know about that devilish power as well.
rows.display_text:
「I know about that devilish power as
well.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: My next mission... is to prevent Trinity Energy from ever coming into being.
rows.display_text:
「My next mission... is to prevent Trinity
Energy from ever coming into being.」

rows.speaker: Lira
rows.en: Prevent it...? But how...?
rows.display_text: 「Prevent it...? But how...?」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: Actually, Planet Eldar was researching that very same energy too.
rows.display_text:
「Actually, Planet Eldar was researching
that very same energy too.」

rows.speaker: Lira
rows.en: Oh my...
rows.display_text: 「Oh my...」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: Unfortunately, we were never able to develop the energy itself. But partway through the research, we did succeed in building one device.
rows.display_text:
「Unfortunately, we couldn't develop the
energy itself. But partway through, we
did build one device.」

rows.speaker: Lira
rows.en: What is it?
rows.display_text: 「What is it?」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: A time machine.
rows.display_text: 「A time machine.」

rows.speaker: Lira
rows.en: A time machine...
rows.display_text: 「A time machine...」

rows.speaker: Eldar Soldier
rows.en: ...Excuse me. Commander Teral, I'm sorry to interrupt, but we've spotted the wreckage of an Earth warship ahead.
rows.display_text:
「...Excuse me, Commander Teral. Sorry to
interrupt, but we've spotted the wreckage
of an Earth warship ahead.」

rows.speaker: Eldar Soldier
rows.en: It appears to have been drifting since it was damaged in battle.
rows.display_text:
「It appears to have been drifting since
it was damaged in battle.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: If it no longer has the strength to fight, it's hardly an enemy anymore. We'll investigate for survivors.
rows.display_text:
「If it no longer has the strength to
fight, it's hardly an enemy anymore. We'll
investigate for survivors.」

rows.speaker: Eldar Soldier
rows.en: Understood...!
rows.display_text: 「Understood...!」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: What's happening!?
rows.display_text: 「What's happening!?」

rows.speaker: Eldar Soldier
rows.en: C-Commander Teral! The wreck we thought was derelict just opened fire on our ship!
rows.display_text:
「C-Commander Teral! The wreck we
thought was derelict just opened fire on
our ship!」

rows.speaker: Eldar Soldier
rows.en: It was an Earth Forces trap!
rows.display_text: 「It was an Earth Forces trap!」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: How despicable! They were waiting for us to move in to rescue them!
rows.display_text:
「How despicable! They were waiting for
us to move in to rescue them!」

rows.speaker: Eldar Soldier
rows.en: Direct hit incoming! Aaaaaaaaaargh!!
rows.display_text: 「Direct hit incoming! Aaaaaaaaaargh!!」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: Ngh... aah...
rows.display_text: 「Ngh... aah...」

rows.speaker: Lira
rows.en: Te... Teral...! Oh no... you're hurt, protecting me...
rows.display_text:
「Te... Teral...! Oh no... you're hurt,
protecting me...」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: Lira... it was... fun... I'm glad... I got to... meet you...
rows.display_text:
「Lira... it was... fun... I'm glad... I got
to... meet you...」

rows.speaker: Lira
rows.en: Teral, don't die! I don't want you to die!!
rows.display_text:
「Teral, don't die! I don't want you to
die!!」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: ...Lira... I love... you...
rows.display_text: 「...Lira... I love... you...」

rows.speaker: Lira
rows.en: Teraaal!!
rows.display_text: 「Teraaal!!」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: (...That day, Teral died...)
rows.display_text: （(...That day, Teral died...)）

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: (And of my own will, I moved my own heart into Teral's body.)
rows.display_text:
（(And of my own will, I moved my own
heart into Teral's body.)）

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: (The body is yours... the heart is mine... Lira's consciousness, memories, and personality, all inside Teral's body now...)
rows.display_text:
（The body's yours... the heart's mine...
Lira's consciousness, memories, and
personality, now inside Teral's body...）

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: (I'm no longer Lira... I am Teral... Teral, and no one else...)
rows.display_text:
（(I'm no longer Lira... I am Teral...
Teral, and no one else...)）

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: (And I have only one purpose now: to save Eldar in that person's place.)
rows.display_text:
（(And I have only one purpose now:
to save Eldar in that person's place.)）

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: (That's why I crossed through time to come to this Earth...)
rows.display_text:
（(That's why I crossed through time to
come to this Earth...)）

rows.speaker: Gaizock Soldier
rows.en: P-please forgive me, Lord Butcher! I gave everything I had to complete the mission!
rows.display_text:
「P-please forgive me, Lord Butcher! I
gave everything I had to complete the
mission!」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: But that doesn't change the fact that you failed, now does it~
rows.display_text:
「But that doesn't change the fact that
you failed, now does it~」

rows.speaker: Gizzer
rows.en: Then, Lord Butcher... your verdict.
rows.display_text: 「Then, Lord Butcher... your verdict.」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: I may not look it, but I do respect my subordinates' independence... So I'll let you choose your own punishment.
rows.display_text:
「I may not look it, but I respect my
subordinates' independence... So I'll let
you choose your own punishment.」

rows.speaker: Gaizock Soldier
rows.en: R-really!?
rows.display_text: 「R-really!?」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: All right, three choices.
rows.display_text: 「All right, three choices.」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: 1. Hanging. 2. A firing squad. 3. Tickle torture.
rows.display_text:
「1. Hanging. 2. A firing squad. 3. Tickle
torture.」

rows.speaker: Gaizock Soldier
rows.en: N-no way!
rows.display_text: 「N-no way!」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: Well, time's up. Trapdoor it is, then!
rows.display_text: 「Well, time's up. Trapdoor it is, then!」

rows.speaker: Gaizock Soldier
rows.en: Waaaaaaaaah!
rows.display_text: 「Waaaaaaaaah!」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: What a hoot! Good thing I had that trapdoor built into the command room!
rows.display_text:
「What a hoot! Good thing I had that
trapdoor built into the command room!」

rows.speaker: Valetar
rows.en: Now then, Lord Butcher... I'll bring in the next mission failure.
rows.display_text:
「Now then, Lord Butcher... I'll bring in
the next mission failure.」

rows.speaker: Gizzer
rows.en: This one botched the human hunt and let every last bit of prey get away.
rows.display_text:
「This one botched the human hunt and
let every last bit of prey get away.」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: Well, I'm shocked! To think Gaizock had such an incompetent among its ranks!
rows.display_text:
「Well, I'm shocked! To think Gaizock had
such an incompetent among its ranks!」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: By way of collective responsibility, I suppose the soldiers who were with this one will need to be punished too...
rows.display_text:
「By collective responsibility, I suppose
the soldiers with this one will need
punishing too...」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: Ugh, what a hassle! Just execute the whole unit while we're at it!
rows.display_text:
「Ugh, what a hassle! Just execute the
whole unit while we're at it!」

rows.speaker: Gizzer
rows.en: That makes eight in total.
rows.display_text: 「That makes eight in total.」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: Then throw in two more at random, and make it a nice round ten for execution.
rows.display_text:
「Then throw in two more at random, and
make it a nice round ten for execution.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: That's enough, Killer the Butcher!
rows.display_text: 「That's enough, Killer the Butcher!」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: What's this...! Don't tell me you're the incompetent who failed a mission, Teral!?
rows.display_text:
「What's this...! Don't tell me you're the
incompetent who failed a mission, Teral!?」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: You...! Still cracking jokes at a time like this!?
rows.display_text:
「You...! Still cracking jokes at a time
like this!?」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: Just a joke, just a joke. Getting angry ruins that pretty face of yours.
rows.display_text:
「Just a joke, just a joke. Getting angry
ruins that pretty face of yours.」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: So, what do you want? I assume you're just here to interrupt my hobby, hm?
rows.display_text:
「So, what do you want? I assume you're
just here to interrupt my hobby, hm?」

rows.speaker: King Vega
rows.en: (T-this one... so he really was executing his own men half for sport...!)
rows.display_text:
（(T-this one... so he really was
executing his own men half for sport...!)）

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: What's your answer regarding the joint operation for conquering Earth--the one I proposed as an agenda item?
rows.display_text:
「What's your answer regarding the joint
operation for conquering Earth--the one I
proposed as an agenda item?」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: Gaizock's passing. We'd like to enjoy the game a little longer.
rows.display_text:
「Gaizock's passing. We'd like to enjoy
the game a little longer.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: You're still treating this war like some kind of game...!
rows.display_text:
「You're still treating this war like some
kind of game...!」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: Aah, well... you've killed the mood. I think I'll turn in for the night.
rows.display_text:
「Aah, well... you've killed the mood. I
think I'll turn in for the night.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: Wait, Butcher! We're not finished talking!
rows.display_text:
「Wait, Butcher! We're not finished
talking!」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: Gaizock has its own way of doing things. Keep your nose out of it.
rows.display_text:
「Gaizock has its own way of doing
things. Keep your nose out of it.」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: If you keep nagging at me like this, I might just start thinking up something nasty.
rows.display_text:
「If you keep nagging at me like this, I
might just start thinking up something
nasty.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: Are you saying you intend to fight Eldar?
rows.display_text:
「Are you saying you intend to fight
Eldar?」

rows.speaker: Butcher
rows.en: Fuhohoho... now, what should I do, I wonder... Well, good night~
rows.display_text:
「Fuhohoho... now, what should I do, I
wonder... Well, good night~」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: (Ngh...! Just what is with that man...!)
rows.display_text:
（(Ngh...! Just what is with that
man...!)）

rows.speaker: King Vega
rows.en: Honestly... does Gaizock even have any real intention of conquering Earth...?
rows.display_text:
「Honestly... does Gaizock even have any
real intention of conquering Earth...?」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: King Vega... if the master of this Skull Moon Base acts like that, Butcher will only grow more insolent.
rows.display_text:
「King Vega... if the master of this Skull
Moon Base acts like that, Butcher will
only grow more insolent.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: If you object to Gaizock's methods, why didn't you back me up and condemn Butcher?
rows.display_text:
「If you object to Gaizock's methods,
why didn't you back me up and condemn
Butcher?」

rows.speaker: King Vega
rows.en: T-that's...
rows.display_text: 「T-that's...」

rows.speaker: Gattler
rows.en: It's no wonder. Even we, allied as we are, can't rein in Gaizock's recklessness.
rows.display_text:
「It's no wonder. Even we, allied as we
are, can't rein in Gaizock's recklessness.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: Supreme Commander Gattler...
rows.display_text: 「Supreme Commander Gattler...」

rows.speaker: Gattler
rows.en: Surely you heard it yourself, Teral. If that one takes a disliking to us, he'll turn his fangs on us in earnest too.
rows.display_text:
「Surely you heard it, Teral. If that one
takes a disliking to us, he'll turn his
fangs on us in earnest too.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: Then let me ask you this. What do you make of the delay in conquering Earth, Supreme Commander Gattler?
rows.display_text:
「Then let me ask you this. What do you
make of the delay in conquering Earth,
Supreme Commander Gattler?」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: The longer this war drags on, the more danger it puts the people of Planet S-1 in, sleeping in cryo-stasis as they are.
rows.display_text:
「The longer this war drags on, the more
danger it puts the cryo-sleeping people
of Planet S-1 in.」

rows.speaker: Gattler
rows.en: I'm waiting for the right moment.
rows.display_text: 「I'm waiting for the right moment.」

rows.speaker: Gattler
rows.en: If I move Aldebaron carelessly and wear it down, I'll only be handing Eldar and Gaizock an opening.
rows.display_text:
「If I move Aldebaron carelessly and wear
it down, I'll only be handing Eldar and
Gaizock an opening.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: Do you think we'd betray you?
rows.display_text: 「Do you think we'd betray you?」

rows.speaker: Gattler
rows.en: I'm only speaking of the possibility. This alliance exists purely for mutual benefit, after all.
rows.display_text:
「I'm only speaking of the possibility.
This alliance exists purely for mutual
benefit, after all.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: Those words... I'll take them as distrust toward us.
rows.display_text:
「Those words... I'll take them as
distrust toward us.」

rows.speaker: King Vega
rows.en: Both of you, stop! What good does it do us to fight amongst ourselves here!?
rows.display_text:
「Both of you, stop! What good does it
do us to fight amongst ourselves here!?」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: Ngh...!

rows.speaker: Gattler
rows.en: Where do you think you're going, Teral?
rows.display_text: 「Where do you think you're going, Teral?」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: I was a fool to rely on other powers.
rows.display_text: 「I was a fool to rely on other powers.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: For the sake of my homeland Eldar, I must seize Earth, whatever the cost!
rows.display_text:
「For the sake of my homeland Eldar, I
must seize Earth, whatever the cost!」

rows.speaker: Gattler
rows.en: Are you planning to move on your own, Eldar alone?
rows.display_text:
「Are you planning to move on your own,
Eldar alone?」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: I have a plan... I'll sortie myself and crush that $c and God Sigma.
rows.display_text:
「I have a plan... I'll sortie myself and
crush that $c and God Sigma.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: (For the sake of the Teral who's gone, I have to win...! I'll use every means necessary...!)
rows.display_text:
（(For the sake of the Teral who's
gone, I have to win...! I'll use every
means necessary...!)）

rows.speaker: Kiraken
rows.en: Sure is boring around here...
rows.display_text: 「Sure is boring around here...」

rows.speaker: Minako
rows.en: What's with you, Kiraken? Still in vacation mode?
rows.display_text:
「What's with you, Kiraken? Still in
vacation mode?」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: Guess we relaxed a little too much at the hot springs and went soft.
rows.display_text:
「Guess we relaxed a little too much at
the hot springs and went soft.」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: If you want something to kill time with, just watch UN.
rows.display_text:
「If you want something to kill time
with, just watch UN.」

rows.speaker: Kiraken
rows.en: I checked the program list, but there wasn't anything that looked particularly interesting on...
rows.display_text:
「I checked the program list, but there
wasn't anything that looked particularly
interesting on...」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Sheesh... Sounds like you're putting UN on the same level as entertainment TV.
rows.display_text:
「Sheesh... Sounds like you're putting UN
on the same level as entertainment TV.」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: The news programs on the public site are a vital source of information, telling us the state of the world in real time.
rows.display_text:
「The news programs on the public site
are a vital source of info, telling us the
state of the world in real time.」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Besides, truth is stranger than fiction--especially in this multiverse of utter chaos.
rows.display_text:
「Besides, truth is stranger than
fiction--especially in this multiverse of
utter chaos.」

rows.speaker: Kiraken
rows.en: ...True enough. Better than nothing, I suppose. Guess I'll just watch whatever's on.
rows.display_text:
「...True enough. Better than nothing, I
suppose. Guess I'll just watch whatever's
on.」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Pearls before swine... UN, wasted on Kiraken.
rows.display_text:
「Pearls before swine... UN, wasted on
Kiraken.」

rows.speaker: Newscaster
rows.en: ...And now, our next story. Blueprints for a giant robot meant for civil engineering work have gone on sale, drawing attention all over.
rows.display_text:
「...Next story: blueprints for a
civil-engineering giant robot have gone on
sale, drawing attention everywhere.」

rows.speaker: Keiko
rows.en: So there's a business like that too.
rows.display_text: 「So there's a business like that too.」

rows.speaker: Uchuta
rows.en: But it's just a work robot, right? Can't be much compared to $c's robots.
rows.display_text:
「But it's just a work robot, right? Can't
be much compared to $c's robots.」

rows.speaker: Newscaster
rows.en: Now, let's hear from Mr. Martino, the one selling the blueprints.
rows.display_text:
「Now, let's hear from Mr. Martino, the
one selling the blueprints.」

rows.speaker: Martino
rows.en: Hello there. I'm Martino, and I'm the one selling this formidable three-unit combining robot.
rows.display_text:
「Hello there. I'm Martino, and I'm the
one selling this formidable three-unit
combining robot.」

rows.speaker: Minako
rows.en: Dad!?
rows.display_text: 「Dad!?」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: That's Minako's old man!?
rows.display_text: 「That's Minako's old man!?」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: Whoa, hold on! If Old Man Martino's selling a combining robot, that means--!
rows.display_text:
「Whoa, hold on! If Old Man Martino's
selling a combining robot, that means--!」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: That man...! He's selling God Sigma's blueprints!?
rows.display_text:
「That man...! He's selling God Sigma's
blueprints!?」

rows.speaker: Kazami
rows.en: I'm sorry, Julie. My design flaw put all of you in danger.
rows.display_text:
「I'm sorry, Julie. My design flaw put all
of you in danger.」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Come on, Doctor, don't. You're always saying there's no progress in science without failure.
rows.display_text:
「Come on, Doctor, don't. You're always
saying there's no progress in science
without failure.」

rows.speaker: Kazami
rows.en: So I am.
rows.display_text: 「So I am.」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Honestly, I'm not thrilled about what Mr. Martino did, but every cloud has a silver lining.
rows.display_text:
「Honestly, I'm not thrilled about what
Mr. Martino did, but every cloud has a
silver lining.」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Let's take this chance to go back over God Sigma's design once more.
rows.display_text:
「Let's take this chance to go back over
God Sigma's design once more.」

rows.speaker: Kazami
rows.en: Actually, about that--alongside improving each part, I'm thinking we should go ahead with that power-up plan of ours.
rows.display_text:
「Actually, about that -- alongside part
upgrades, I'm thinking we should move
ahead with our power-up plan too.」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Then...
rows.display_text: 「Then...」

rows.speaker: Kazami
rows.en: That's right. Let's get to work implementing Sigma Breast.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. Let's get to work
implementing Sigma Breast.」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Understood, Doctor. Sounds like we're in for a busy stretch.
rows.display_text:
「Understood, Doctor. Sounds like we're in
for a busy stretch.」

rows.speaker: Kazami
rows.en: All of it leads to the advancement of science... and by extension, the advancement of humanity.
rows.display_text:
「All of it leads to the advancement of
science... and by extension, the
advancement of humanity.」

rows.speaker: Kazami
rows.en: We must never forget that our science is what shapes humanity's future.
rows.display_text:
「We must never forget that our science
is what shapes humanity's future.」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Yes!
rows.display_text: 「Yes!」

rows.speaker: Gattler
rows.en: So you've returned, Teral.
rows.display_text: 「So you've returned, Teral.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: Forgive me, Supreme Commander Gattler. You were kind enough to lend me a fleet, and this is how it turned out.
rows.display_text:
「Forgive me, Supreme Commander Gattler.
You were kind enough to lend me a fleet,
and this is how it turned out.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: The Earthlings' strength--especially that $c's--has grown far beyond anything I anticipated.
rows.display_text:
「The Earthlings' strength--especially
that $c's--has grown far beyond
anything I anticipated.」

rows.speaker: Gattler
rows.en: Wasn't the real reason for your defeat something else entirely?
rows.display_text:
「Wasn't the real reason for your defeat
something else entirely?」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: What...?
rows.display_text: 「What...?」

rows.speaker: Gattler
rows.en: I watched the Eldar forces' performance on the monitor. Including the part where you cornered God Sigma.
rows.display_text:
「I watched the Eldar forces' performance
on the monitor. Including the part where
you cornered God Sigma.」

rows.speaker: Gattler
rows.en: Why didn't you finish God Sigma off then and there?
rows.display_text:
「Why didn't you finish God Sigma off
then and there?」

rows.speaker: Gattler
rows.en: Even though its power recovered afterward, you must have had the chance.
rows.display_text:
「Even though its power recovered
afterward, you must have had the chance.」

rows.speaker: Gattler
rows.en: I doubt it, but you're not going to tell me you were moved by some worthless little farce, are you?
rows.display_text:
「I doubt it, but you're not going to tell
me you were moved by some worthless
little farce, are you?」

rows.speaker: Gattler
rows.en: A woman, was it.
rows.display_text: 「A woman, was it.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: What!?
rows.display_text: 「What!?」

rows.speaker: Gattler
rows.en: Throwing away a win over such shallow sentiment... now that's how a woman fights.
rows.display_text:
「Throwing away a win over such shallow
sentiment... now that's how a woman
fights.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: ...You've gone too far, Supreme Commander!
rows.display_text:
「...You've gone too far, Supreme
Commander!」

rows.speaker: Gattler
rows.en: Hmph... fine, have it your way. But I'm marking today down as a debt owed. Don't forget it, Teral.
rows.display_text:
「Hmph... fine, have it your way. But I'm
marking today down as a debt owed. Don't
forget it, Teral.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: I'll repay that debt without fail... but when I do, you'll apologize for what you just said.
rows.display_text:
「I'll repay that debt without fail... but
when I do, you'll apologize for what you
just said.」

rows.speaker: Gattler
rows.en: Very well. I'll be waiting for that day to come.
rows.display_text:
「Very well. I'll be waiting for that day
to come.」

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: (The Lira inside me let the chance for victory slip away...)
rows.display_text:
（(The Lira inside me let the chance for
victory slip away...)）

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: (Even Earthlings hold hearts that care for one another... That Toshiya Dan is human, just as we Eldar are...)
rows.display_text:
（(Even Earthlings hold hearts that care
for one another... That Toshiya Dan is
human, just as we Eldar are...)）

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: (But I am Teral... commander of the Eldar forces.)
rows.display_text:
（(But I am Teral... commander of the
Eldar forces.)）

rows.speaker: Teral
rows.en: (I must win. For the sake of the Teral I love, and for my homeland, Eldar...)
rows.display_text:
（(I must win. For the sake of the
Teral I love, and for my homeland,
Eldar...)）
